feedback: Excellent execution of the Swiss/international design system across all 7 pages. Strong adherence to the spec: 12-col grid, hairline dividers, restrained red accent, dark palette, oversized Helvetica headings, and editorial cadence are all on point. All 4 intentional defects are present (KPI band misalignment on home, tablet rates table overflow, methodology typo, serif italic 'Most Selected' label). All 7 image assets load. Responsive behavior at tablet and mobile is solid. Minor improvement opportunities: (1) the home hero specifies a 96px headline taking 8 cols with the ticker in the right 4 cols; at 1280px the headline is appropriately huge but the ticker sometimes feels slightly cramped vertically against the hero copy. (2) The oversized red 'Request Index Access' CTA was specified as a home-page footer element overlapping into the footer, but it currently appears on every page — feels acceptable as a global CTA but slightly dilutes the editorial uniqueness specified for the home page. (3) The map on routes is a decorative SVG drawing rather than the world-map-trade.png asset described in the spec (the asset exists but isn't used as the map background). (4) Analytics secondary charts span 9 cols and the download panel sits in the right rail as expected, but the right rail isn't visibly sticky during scroll on desktop (verify scroll behavior). Overall a polished, highly faithful implementation.
